## What this dashboard shows

- Consolidated view of Wipro Enterprises group performance across multiple ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA, Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Tally Prime) covering Consumer Care & Lighting, Infrastructure Engineering, and Joint Ventures businesses
- Group revenue after eliminations is ₹2368.34B with ₹9.59B intercompany eliminated, generating EBITDA of ₹681.84B
- Strong YTD growth of +17.4% (Jan–Jul 2026 vs 2025) with gross margin at 47.7% and EBITDA margin at 28.8%

## What to report

- Revenue grew +17.4% year-to-date (Jan–Jul 2026 vs 2025) reaching ₹2368.34B after eliminations, driven primarily by businesses excluding Joint Ventures (+₹62.01B, 85.2% of total change) and SAP product sales (+₹57.64B, 79.2% of change)
- Group profitability remains healthy with gross margin of 47.7% and EBITDA margin of 28.8%, delivering ₹681.84B EBITDA
- Cash position stands at ₹598.47B as of July 2026, with working capital showing DSO of 123 days and extended supplier payment terms at DPO of 300 days
- Wipro Consumer Care International is the largest business at ₹782.67B revenue with the strongest EBITDA margin of 43.3%, while Wipro Infrastructure Engineering contributed ₹260.27B (all ₹9.59B of intercompany eliminations)

## Watch out for

- Wipro Consumer Care International has exceptionally long working capital cycles with DSO of 207 days and DPO of 612 days—significantly above group average—question whether this reflects contractual terms, collection issues, or supplier financing arrangements
- Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery shows the weakest profitability at 14.2% EBITDA margin and 36.1% gross margin; investigate whether this reflects competitive pressure, cost structure issues, or business model differences
- The dashboard includes simulated data sources ("Simulated SAP" and "Simulated SAP S/4HANA") alongside real data—confirm which entities use simulated data and the accuracy implications for board reporting
- Revenue by business and EBITDA margin by company are calculated before intercompany eliminations, while headline revenue is after eliminations (₹2368.34B vs sum of company revenues ₹2377.93B); ensure board understands the ₹9.59B reconciliation
